label: National childcare fee support — ages 3 to 5
appliesTo: The national programme for eligible children. A municipal foreign-child programme is a different payment with its own rules, even where the monthly figure happens to match.
why: This number collides with Incheon's foreign-child subsidy at the same amount, which is how '₩280,000 for daycare in Korea' spreads as if it were one nationwide entitlement. Two programmes, two eligibility tests, one coincidence.

history.note: Recorded at the date this site first verified it.
